output.why: The WSWS transfer pumps are explicitly specified as a 2 working + 1 standby (2W+1S, 3x50%) configuration at 125 m3/hr each, with mandatory control interlocks for automatic standby pump starting upon failure/tripping of a running pump. Furthermore, running all three pumps simultaneously produces 375 m3/hr (150% of the 250 m3/hr design flow of the single working Lamella Clarifier), which exceeds the ETP hydraulic occasional overloading design limit of 20% (300 m3/hr).
